BETA Close X Currys PLC has purchased 1,391,665 of its ordinary shares for cancellation on March 31, 2026, at prices ranging from 119.70p to 124.30p per share. Following this transaction, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 1,097,877,400, with no shares held in treasury. This updated total represents the company's total voting rights. No Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. This number represents the total voting rights in the Company and may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they can determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in the Company under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
